# vpsie_server_group (Resource)

Manages a VPSie server (VM) group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vpsie_server_group" "example" {
  group_name        = "web-tier"
  group_description = "Front-end web servers"
  is_distributed    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_name` (String) The name of the server group.

### Optional

- `group_description` (String) The description of the server group.
- `is_distributed` (Boolean) Whether the group's servers are distributed across hosts.

### Read-Only

- `created_on` (String) The creation timestamp of the server group.
- `identifier` (String) The unique identifier of the server group.
